crumbs.name: Knowledge Based Professions and their Future

children.name: Tax Structuring and Planning
children.blurb: Tax structuring and planning covers how AI businesses choose entity forms, locations, transfer pricing, IP ownership, and financing arrangements to manage tax obligations across jurisdictions.

children.name: Transfer Pricing
children.blurb: Transfer pricing covers the prices charged between related legal entities for goods, services, intangibles, and financing.

children.name: Research Credits from Engineering Records
children.blurb: Research credits from engineering records concern the use of technical documentation, version histories, test logs, and design notes to substantiate research and development tax credit claims.

children.name: Sales, Use and Value Added Tax
children.blurb: Sales tax, use tax, and value added tax are transaction taxes levied on goods and services, with sales tax charged at the point of sale, use tax owed on taxable purchases where sales tax was not collected, and VAT applied at each stage of production with credit for input tax.

children.name: Audit Defence and Controversy
children.blurb: Audit defence and controversy covers the work of preparing for, responding to, and resolving disputes with tax authorities over positions that involve AI systems, data, or automated decisions.

sections.body: This field covers how companies that build or use AI handle tax obligations and jurisdictional rules. Artificial intelligence is now doing concrete work in classifying transactions, reading tax code changes, and preparing supporting documents for filings. In transfer pricing, software compares intercompany agreements and actual system logs to test whether stated functions match reality. For research credits, tools scan engineering repositories, commit histories, and time tracking data to identify qualifying activities. For indirect tax, systems map product and service lines to tax categories across different regions and flag registration thresholds.
sections.heading: What this covers

sections.body: The work is uneven. Routine classification and document retrieval are fairly reliable where rules are stable and data is clean. Transfer pricing analysis still depends heavily on human judgment because comparable data is scarce and AI models can miss unusual business facts. Research credit identification from engineering records works best in companies with disciplined commit messages and issue tracking, and poorly where records are messy. Sales and use tax engines handle common digital goods well but struggle with bundled AI services and changing local definitions. Audit defence tools can organize evidence and predict likely questions, but they do not replace a tax professional's judgment under examination.
sections.heading: Where the work stands

sections.body: Tax Structuring and Planning explains how AI models are used to compare entity and financing options across jurisdictions. Transfer Pricing covers the tools that test whether intercompany pricing matches actual functions and risks. Research Credits from Engineering Records shows how source code and project data are mined for qualifying activities. Sales, Use and Value Added Tax describes the classification and registration engines for indirect tax. Audit Defence and Controversy covers evidence assembly, issue spotting, and response drafting when a position is challenged.
